verses.en: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.pt: Depois disto Jó abriu sua boca, e amaldiçoou seu dia.
verses.en_web: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
verses.en_bbe: Then, opening his mouth, and cursing the day of his birth,

verses.en: And Job spake, and said,
verses.pt: Pois Jó respondeu, e disse:
verses.en_web: Job answered:
verses.en_bbe: Job made answer and said,

verses.en: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
verses.pt: Pereça o dia em que nasci, e a noite em que se disse: Um homem foi concebido.
verses.en_web: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
verses.en_bbe: Let destruction take the day of my birth, and the night on which it was said, A man child has come into the world.

verses.en: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.pt: Torne-se aquele dia em trevas; Deus não lhe dê atenção desde acima, nem claridade brilhe sobre ele.
verses.en_web: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
verses.en_bbe: That day--let it be dark; let not God take note of it from on high, and let not the light be shining on it;

verses.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.pt: Reivindiquem-no para si trevas e sombra de morte; nuvens habitem sobre ele; a escuridão do dia o espante.
verses.en_web: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day terrify it.
verses.en_bbe: Let the dark and the black night take it for themselves; let it be covered with a cloud; let the dark shades of day send fear on it.

verses.en: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.pt: Tome a escuridão aquela noite; não seja contada entre os dias do ano, nem faça parte do número dos meses.
verses.en_web: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.en_bbe: That night--let the thick dark take it; let it not have joy among the days of the year; let it not come into the number of the months.

verses.en: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.pt: Ah se aquela noite fosse solitária, e música de alegria não viesse a ela!
verses.en_web: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.en_bbe: As for that night, let it have no fruit; let no voice of joy be sounded in it;

verses.en: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
verses.pt: Amaldiçoem-na os que amaldiçoam o dia, os que se preparam para levantar seu pranto.
verses.en_web: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
verses.en_bbe: Let it be cursed by those who put a curse on the day; who are ready to make Leviathan awake.

verses.en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
verses.pt: Escureçam-se as estrelas de sua manhã; espere a luz, e não venha, e as pálpebras não vejam o amanhecer;
verses.en_web: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,
verses.en_bbe: Let its morning stars be dark; let it be looking for light, but may it not have any; let it not see the eyes of the dawn.

verses.en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
verses.pt: Pois não fechou as portas do ventre onde eu estava, nem escondeu de meus olhos o sofrimento.
verses.en_web: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
verses.en_bbe: Because it did not keep the doors of my mother's body shut, so that trouble might be veiled from my eyes.

verses.en: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
verses.pt: Por que eu não morri desde a madre, ou perdi a vida ao sair do ventre?
verses.en_web: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
verses.en_bbe: Why did death not take me when I came out of my mother's body, why did I not, when I came out, give up my last breath?

verses.en: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
verses.pt: Por que joelhos me receberam? E por que seios me amamentaram?
verses.en_web: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
verses.en_bbe: Why did the knees take me, or why the breasts that they might give me milk?

verses.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
verses.pt: Pois agora eu jazeria e repousaria; dormiria, e então haveria repouso para mim;
verses.en_web: For now should I have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
verses.en_bbe: For then I might have gone to my rest in quiet, and in sleep have been in peace,

verses.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
verses.pt: Com os reis e os conselheiros da terra, que edificavam para si os desertos;
verses.en_web: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
verses.en_bbe: With kings and the wise ones of the earth, who put up great houses for themselves;

verses.en: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.pt: Ou com os príncipes que tinham ouro, que enchiam suas casas de prata.
verses.en_web: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.en_bbe: Or with rulers who had gold, and whose houses were full of silver;

verses.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
verses.pt: Ou por que não fui como um aborto oculto, como as crianças que nunca viram a luz?
verses.en_web: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
verses.en_bbe: Or as a child dead at birth I might never have come into existence; like young children who have not seen the light.

verses.en: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
verses.pt: Ali os maus deixam de perturbar, e ali repousam os cansados de forças.
verses.en_web: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
verses.en_bbe: There the passions of the evil are over, and those whose strength has come to an end have rest.

verses.en: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
verses.pt: Ali os prisioneiros juntamente repousam; e não ouvem a voz do opressor.
verses.en_web: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
verses.en_bbe: There the prisoners are at peace together; the voice of the overseer comes not again to their ears.

verses.en: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
verses.pt: Ali estão o pequeno e o grande; e o servo livre está de seu senhor.
verses.en_web: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.
verses.en_bbe: The small and the great are there, and the servant is free from his master.

verses.en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
verses.pt: Por que se dá luz ao sofredor, e vida aos amargos de alma,
verses.en_web: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
verses.en_bbe: Why does he give light to him who is in trouble, and life to the bitter in soul;

verses.en: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.pt: Que esperam a morte, e ela não chega, e que a buscam mais que tesouros;
verses.en_web: Who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
verses.en_bbe: To those whose desire is for death, but it comes not; who are searching for it more than for secret wealth;

verses.en: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.pt: Que saltam de alegram e ficam contentes quando acham a sepultura?
verses.en_web: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.en_bbe: Who are glad with great joy, and full of delight when they come to their last resting-place;

verses.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
verses.pt: E também ao homem cujo caminho é oculto, e a quem Deus o encobriu?
verses.en_web: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
verses.en_bbe: To a man whose way is veiled, and who is shut in by God?

verses.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
verses.pt: Pois antes do meu pão vem meu suspiro; e meus gemidos correm como águas.
verses.en_web: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
verses.en_bbe: In place of my food I have grief, and cries of sorrow come from me like water.

verses.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verses.pt: Pois aquilo eu temia tanto veio a mim, e aquilo que tinha medo me aconteceu.
verses.en_web: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.
verses.en_bbe: For I have a fear and it comes on me, and my heart is greatly troubled.

verses.en: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
verses.pt: Não tenho tido descanso, nem tranquilidade, nem repouso; mas perturbação veio sobre mim.
verses.en_web: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; but trouble comes.”
verses.en_bbe: I have no peace, no quiet, and no rest; nothing but pain comes on me.
